name: Bento
description: Full-bleed media tile with a top-left app icon and a bottom-left headline/body/CTA lockup. Light/dark is token-driven — the text uses theme-aware content tokens that flip with :root[data-theme], so there is no light/dark variant. `width` sets the proportion: full (wide row hero) or third (squarer tile for a 3-up grid). Scales with its container via aspect-ratio — never fixed pixel dimensions.

props.name: width
props.description: Tile proportion — full: 1392/711 wide hero · third: 692/711 squarer grid tile

props.name: app
props.description: App slug passed to AppIcon for the top-left badge

props.name: imageSrc
props.description: Image URL — fills the media as a full-bleed background

props.name: imageAlt
props.description: Alt text; leave empty when the media is decorative (default)

responsive.<600px: both collapse to a 327/469 portrait so the lockup keeps room

notes: Media is decorative (aria-hidden); the headline/body carry the meaning — provide imageAlt only when the image conveys information not in the copy.
No scrim: text legibility depends on image selection. Verify 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG 1.4.3) against the region of the image the text overlays, in both themes.
CTA renders as a real <a>; keyboard focus shows a visible focus ring (WCAG 2.4.7).

Headline renders as

not — heading level is the consumer's responsibility.
